'''Drilling Platform Dopa''' was a mining platform attached to the northern side of the [[Cartel mining mesa]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]]. One of six mining platforms attached to the mesa by the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]], the platform used a mining laser to drill into the planet's core for [[isotope-5]]. During the conflict, [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] forces attacked the platform and commandeered it in order to halt the planet's impending destruction.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Drilling Platform Dopa was added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' along with the rest of the planet Makeb in the [[2013]] Digital Expansion ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
